title: Symphonie Concertante
identity: Jacques Ibert, Symphonie concertante, originally for oboe and string orchestra, arranged by Grégoire Nicole for soprano saxophone and piano. The Leduc edition is AL29268 (1951); Ibert’s work catalogue gives 27 minutes for the original concerto.

evidence.claim: Ibert’s official catalogue identifies the original oboe-and-string-orchestra scoring and the Grégoire Nicole soprano saxophone and piano arrangement, Leduc AL29268, 1951.
Hal Leonard lists the soprano saxophone and piano setting and 46-page edition.
Wise Music’s work page currently describes an alto saxophone and piano scoring, conflicting with the Ibert catalogue’s edition-specific soprano saxophone listing.

collection_flag: This saxophone edition is a transcription of an oboe concerto. The catalog’s inclusion of orchestra should be verified against its soprano sax and piano edition.
gaps: Saxophone arrangement score and saxophone recording not inspected; the current Wise Music alto-sax label conflicts with the edition-specific composer catalogue.
proposed_corrections: Consider removing Orchestra from the instrument fields if the catalog entry is specifically the AL29268 soprano saxophone and piano reduction.
